text:
mia_sales: FYI ACME is asking for a bundled package (API + Optimize + Console add-ons). They want a 6-week POC and a 12mo commit after. Need pricing guidance, deal-desk path, and legal kickoff. tagging @claire_legal @sales_ops @ben_engineering
raj_se: quick q — what's the expected POC scale? tokens/sec, concurrency? SLOs?
mia_sales: POC target ~30 qps, average prompt ~150 tokens, peak 75 qps for short bursts. They want <150ms p95 for short completions.
ben_engineering: for that profile we can do hosted + prefix caching, but dedicated during POC for consistent perf. Dedicated 2w OK if we schedule off-peak.
sales_ops: discount bands for bundles: 10% at $50k/mo commit, 15% at $75k/mo, 18% at $100k/mo. Add-on stacking: we don't double-dip; highest band applies. Any promotional credits are separate.
mia_sales: ACME is asking for 15% on the whole bundle and dedicated POC for 6 weeks + extended support during POC. They also asked for a one-time onboarding credit.
sales_ops: 15% is within standard band but if the net ARR impact > $75k reduction we need Deal Desk signoff. Please provide expected ARR / committed spend number. Also need rate card line items.
mia_sales: rough commit = $80k/mo for 12 months (API tokens + Optimize eval credits + Console seats).
sales_ops: ok that's in the 15% bracket but require formal deal-desk approval. I'll open ticket. Please include SKU breakout.
ben_engineering: SKU notes — API (tokens), Optimize (eval credits + background jobs), Console seats (per-seat dashboard). For POC we can cap token usage and apply a dev-only quota.
claire_legal: I'll kick off legal review. Need the rate card + MSA changes (SOW for POC + 12mo committed terms). Also confirm data protection for Optimize: do they want eval datasets ingested to our hosted infra? If yes, need DPA and potential SOC2 addendum.
mia_sales: they plan to ingest eval datasets to our Optimize service (hosted). They insist on a DPA + SCCs.
claire_legal: note — DPA + SCCs standard. If eval data contains PHI/PII we'll need stronger safeguards. Send the security questionnaire; I'll review answers.
mia_sales: I'll ask ACME for the security questionnaire now.
deploy-bot: Capacity request created: ticket #INC-12345 — dedicated pool allocation (2 GPUs) for ACME POC window 2026-06-02 to 2026-06-16.
ben_engineering: noted ticket. If POC needs 6 weeks we need to extend to 2026-07-14; that requires resource approval. Two-week dedicated window is manageable without major disruption.
sales_ops: for approval flow: 1) submit SKU + commit details 2) Deal Desk review (pricing exception) 3) RevOps acceptance 4) Legal SOW signoff. I'll create the Deal Desk item.
mia_sales: sample SKU/pricing snippet I sent to Deal Desk: ```
API tokens: $0.0009/token est (monthly)
Optimize eval credits: $0.02/credit est
Console seats: $250/seat/mo
Commit: $80,000/mo pre-discount
Requested discount: 15%
Net: $68,000/mo
Onboarding credit: $10,000 one-time
```
raj_se: can we offer a graduated commit ramp (6mo ramp TOC) instead of full 12mo immediate? ACME prefers operational flexibility.
sales_ops: ramp okay as long as committed minimum meets discount threshold by month 4. Need to document ramp schedule in SOW.
claire_legal: I'll draft SOW template with ramp and POC terms. Please attach security questionnaire once ACME returns it.
mia_sales: action items: 1) I'll attach ACME security questionnaire (incoming) 2) Ben to confirm POC duration we can grant without extra cost 3) Sales_ops to open Deal Desk ticket + include SKU breakout 4) Claire to start SOW draft.
ben_engineering: confirm — we can offer 2 weeks dedicated + 4 weeks hosted-high-priority for a 6-week POC. Dedicated beyond 2w needs infra signoff.
sales_ops: created Deal Desk ticket DD-7891 with price math and requested 15% exception. Linking docs.
claire_legal: I've created SOW draft PR and shared with the thread. Will incorporate DPA reference and ramp schedule.
mia_sales: thanks team — I'll update ACME with this plan and loop back when questionnaire comes in. :thumbsup:
